locations.name: Patrón Lunares
locations.description: Proper Mallorcan plates served in a restyled old fishermen's club in Santa Catalina — nautical-social-club room, market fish and island classics, on Carrer de la Fàbrica a few doors from Xoriguer. Filed in the Thursday tapas-crawl plan as the backup if Toque de Queda is slammed; also a solid standalone Santa Catalina dinner. 🚶 14 min from the Palma Riad.
locations.address: Carrer de la Fàbrica, 30, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Tapas-crawl backup: 'proper Mallorcan plates in an old fishermen's club' — use if Toque de Queda is slammed. Santa Catalina, ~10 min west of the crawl.
